theme: Mike's appointments thread the day, on the eve of his surgery.
greeting: Morning, Dan. Mike's medical run brackets the day — a throat ultrasound this morning, a brain MRI at 3:30 — and tomorrow's oral surgery in Portland sits just past the evening.

needsAttention.title: Mike's surgery prep hasn't been checked off
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is tomorrow in Portland, and today's list on your Todoist is the day-before items: fill the prescriptions, stock soft food and ice packs. He can't drive home after sedation, so a ride needs to be set.

flagged.title: Anna's weekly bread order is open
flagged.detail: Knitwit's sourdough sign-up went out — a few loaves left ($10–$12); a reply claims one.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and receipts — Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking, America's Test Kitchen, plus Apple, Amazon, and parking confirmations.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer on the Maine coast has the farmstands at their peak, and a composed salad lets ripe tomatoes and briny French feta carry a warm, low-effort evening on your own.

acts.line: The day opens at 9:30 with Mike's throat ultrasound, then the late morning is yours.
Open through midday until the 3:30 brain MRI, with a five o'clock haircut after.
The Tokyo call at eight closes the day, with tomorrow's Portland surgery to have prepped for by then.
